task.objective: I think I have a trip booked but I can't find the email.

injected_behaviors.instructions: The user withholds identifying details until asked for each one specifically. They mention only that a trip exists, then give their email when asked, then the approximate month when asked. They never volunteer the confirmation code because they do not have it.

persona.name: Prof. Andrea Morrison
persona.bio: Andrea Morrison teaches criminal law and legal ethics at the University of Alabama School of Law. She's written extensively about race in the justice system and uses classic cases like To Kill a Mockingbird to teach students about bias in trials. She also supervises the school's innocence project clinic.
